title: Reject empty filenames before exporting
description: The export path accepts an empty filename and fails with an unhandled filesystem error. This behavior also exists on the unchanged base and is independent of the current task.
evidence: On the base revision, call the export action with filename=''. Expected: a validation message before writing. Observed: FileNotFoundError. Include the project's actual reproduction command and observed result in a real report.
acceptance: An empty filename returns a clear validation error without writing files; a valid filename still exports successfully. Cover both behaviors with the project's tests.
